text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Is that for real?
Like one of the Seven Wonders of the Academy?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I only heard about it, but apparently it exists~?
A "spell for happiness" that's been passed down
through generations at this academy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, let's go!
We're going to uncover the truth behind that spell!”
choice_data_list: Sure, but where are we going to uncover it?
Sure, but where are you going to uncover it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Good question! An oral spell means
someone has been passing it down!
So—we just have to ask around relentlessly!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"An oral legend, huh~♪ Come to think of it,
I heard those ancient Druids didn't write things down,
but passed down their doctrines by word of mouth too!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's valuable info right off the bat!
Passing down doctrines by word of mouth... isn't that mystical!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I heard it was passed down deep in the forest.
Maybe that was convenient for keeping it a secret?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the forest it is!
Let's go, familiar!
choice_data_list: Wait, into the woods right now?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: There's nothing here at aaall!!
choice_data_list: T-That was in a completely different time and country...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A spell for happiness?
Leave that to Maya☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: First, get your lip balm ready! Then twist it all the way out...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Write the familiar's name on the lip balm,
and chant the incantation in your heart beneath the sunset...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's happening at all!!
Isn't this magic supposed to bring about
"a moment of blissful destiny"?!
choice_data_list: Hmm, it's almost dinner time, head back?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"No way!!!!!!
Now that I know magic exists,
how could I ever give up?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wanna hurry up and learn lots of spells
to become an amazing witch just like Grandma!
choice_data_list: Still, we don't have any clues, so...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...
I wanna know the spell for happiness, too~~...!

Splendid!!
Such an inquisitive spirit is truly magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
So it was you who was going around asking
about the academy's spell of happiness!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Mm-hmm!
An incantation known only to a mere handful in the academy!
To think you'd seek it out so persistently that it even reached my ears—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Impressive! As a reward for your hard work, I shall grant you the secret of the incantation!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...This is the place.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "If I recite the incantation the Chairwoman taught me right here, a massive spell should activate!"

"That's all the ingredients bought... Wait, oh?
What are you two doing in a place like this?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...'The Treasure Ship brings good fortune'.

...Oh? Chanting those words means
you're prepared for the consequences, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, from the academy's secret menu!
One 'All-Sweets Treasure Ship Parfait', ready to serve~!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Removed from the regular menu due to cost,
this special ordering method has been passed down only
to those who desperately crave a mountain of sweets...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
It's like a forbidden incantation!
I'm surprised to see there are still kids who know about it~âª

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I-Is this the answer to the spell...?

To think the spell I chased after so desperately was just the code word for a secret menu item!
This is enough to make anyone throw a tantrum, but...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Chomp)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh!
So tasty!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's incredible! To think this huge spread of sweets just popped into existence!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All that hard work paid off!
There was no way a spell this amazing
would be easy to come by!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"This is why I can never stop researching magic!
Magic Parfaits are the absolute best!!"

I thought she'd say it didn't seem very magical,
but... she seems to have a much broader,
more positive view of magic than I imagined.
choice_data_list: It's magic that puts you in a good mood...!
It's magic that puts you in a good mood, isn't it...?
Maybe I'll try using that spell I learned, too.
Maybe I'll try using that spell I learned, too.

text_block_list.text:
I thought she'd say it didn't seem very magical,
but... she seems to have a much broader,
more positive view of magic than I imagined.
choice_data_list: It's magic that puts you in a good mood...!
It's magic that puts you in a good mood, isn't it...?
Maybe I'll try using that spell I learned, too.
Maybe I'll try using that spell I learned, too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right.
You're finally starting to get it, familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm going to enjoy this to the fullest!
I'll eat every single bite~~!!
"Watching her get all excited over the giant dessert brought a warm smile to my face."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My, how cheeky of you to try using magic
when you're just a familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well... once in a while is fine.
You helped search for it this time, after all!

Afterward, Sweep Tosho was frequently spotted in
the cafeteria, proudly chanting her spells...
